mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_vuln_finding(server_id, check_code, source, category, title, severity, status, occurrence_count, recur_count, last_run_id, reg_user) VALUES(#{serverId}, #{checkCode}, #{source}, COALESCE(#{category},'SEC'), #{title}, #{severity}, COALESCE(#{status},'OPEN'), 1, 0, CAST(#{lastRunId} AS uuid), #{regUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE pmc_vuln_finding SET last_detected_at = now(), occurrence_count = occurrence_count + 1, recur_count = recur_count + #{recurInc}, status = #{status}, severity = #{severity}, last_run_id = CAST(#{lastRunId} AS uuid), upd_user = #{updUser}, upd_dt = now() WHERE finding_id = #{findingId}
mapper.select:
SELECT f.finding_id, f.server_id, f.check_code, f.source, f.category, f.title, f.severity, f.status, f.first_detected_at, f.last_detected_at, f.occurrence_count, f.recur_count, CAST(f.last_run_id AS varchar) AS last_run_id, f.reg_dt, f.upd_dt, s.hostname AS hostname, s.service_name AS service_name FROM pmc_vuln_finding f JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id = f.server_id
ORDER BY CASE f.severity WHEN '상' THEN 0 WHEN '중' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, f.last_detected_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT f.finding_id, f.server_id, f.check_code, f.source, f.category, f.title, f.severity, f.status, f.first_detected_at, f.last_detected_at, f.occurrence_count, f.recur_count, CAST(f.last_run_id AS varchar) AS last_run_id, f.reg_dt, f.upd_dt, s.hostname AS hostname, s.service_name AS service_name FROM pmc_vuln_finding f JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id = f.server_id WHERE f.finding_id = #{findingId}

SELECT s.server_id AS "serverId", s.hostname AS "hostname", sum(CASE WHEN f.status = 'RECURRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "recurredCount", sum(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') AND f.severity = '상' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "highOpen", sum(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "openCount", COALESCE(sum(f.recur_count), 0) AS "recurTotal", max(f.last_detected_at) AS "lastDetectedAt" FROM pmc_vuln_finding f JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id = f.server_id GROUP BY s.server_id, s.hostname HAVING sum(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('OPEN','RECURRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY "recurredCount" DESC, "highOpen" DESC
SELECT * FROM pmc_vuln_exception WHERE finding_id = #{findingId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > now() ORDER BY exception_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_vuln_exception(finding_id, reason, approver, status, expires_at, reg_user) VALUES(#{findingId}, #{reason}, #{approver}, COALESCE(#{status},'ACTIVE'), #{expiresAt}, #{regUser})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pmc_vuln_exception WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at <= now()
mapper.update: UPDATE pmc_vuln_exception SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE exception_id = #{exceptionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_vuln_action(finding_id, action_user, action_desc, resulting_status, reg_user) VALUES(#{findingId}, #{actionUser}, #{actionDesc}, #{resultingStatus}, #{regUser})
